The '''2011 SoCal Grand Prix''' (also called the '''2011 San Diego Grand Prix''') was the second annual SoCal Grand Prix, held 7–9 October 2011 at At Ease Games in Poway, California. All events were run by [[Kevin Shannon]].<ref name="ann">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=42328 Official Announcement: SoCal Grand Prix Oct 7-9], forum.starwarsccg.org (11 August 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105003712/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t42328.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Aaron Nelson]] won the main event.<ref name="mew">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/ Major Event Winners], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020230923/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/major-event-winners.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' At Ease Games, 12373 Poway Road, Poway, California<ref name="ann" />
* '''Dates:''' 7–9 October 2011<ref name="ann" />
* '''Schedule:''' Friday team event; Saturday main event Day 1 (8 games Swiss, top 8 to Day 2); Sunday Day 2 and a consolation event<ref name="ann" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]<ref name="ann" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Aaron Nelson]]<ref name="mew" />
